unfinished.detail:
THE SAME CRITICAL THE COMMIT FIXED, ONE DOOR OVER, AND STILL LIVE. `solo` is `hold_out is None`; the condition that makes a pass safe to cache from is `learn` (`training and solo`), which is the gate every other read-only-protection in this body uses (_ground_update, _explore_swap, _spawn_check, the halt EMA, the ae round trip). An ordinary no_grad eval pass therefore still writes a graphless tensor into pop.ident_graph under its own step, and the next training pass matching branch 1 of _identities is handed it.
